title: Aye Mere Chand Meri Ankh ke taare Asghar
body:
Haey Asghar
Haey Asghar
Yeh Roo Kay Kehti Thi
Umm E Rabab Maqtal May
<<DIVIDER>>
Haey.....
Kahan Pey Sotey Ho Maa Kay Bagair Jangal May
Ay Mere Chand Meri
Ankh Kay Tarey Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala Ayi Thi Main, Tere Bharosey Asghar
Haey Afsoa Kay Majood Nahi Hay Paani
Kesi Ghurbat Hay Meri
Maa Bhala Teri Nazar, Kese Utarey Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Hath Shabbir Ki Gardan Per Rakhy Thy Jese
Teer Bhi Chalty Hue
Fatima Aa Kay Khari Thi Tere Aagay Asghar
Tum Bhi Abbas Ho Kusar Pey Nahi Jana Abhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Laaj Rakh Lena Meri
Hay Abhi Ehl E Haram Dasht May Piyase Asghar
Teer Ek Bar To Ek Bar Chalaye Khanjar
Mere Mazloom Pisr
<<DIVIDER>>
Zibhaa Doo Bar Hua Koi Na Aese Asghar
Tum Nay Hans Hans K Rulaya Tha Jinhe Mere Pisr
Haey Pathar Ly Kar
Ab Sakina Say Wahi Lete Hain Badlay Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Haey Asghar
Shamiyun Ki Naa Nazar Unky Khulay Sir Pey Parey
Apni Behno K Liye
Tum Bhi Quran Parho
<<DIVIDER>>
Nok E Sinaa Say Asghar, Haey Asghar
Teer Khatey Huey Khud Dekha Hay Mene Tumko
Ab To Yeh Zulm Na Ho
Koi Pathar Na Lagey Sir Pey Tumhare Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Pusht E Khyma Pey Banatey Thy Lahad Teri Padar
Jhuk Gai Meri Qamar
Chand Lamho Ko Teri Laash Utha Kay Asghar
Laash Uthani Hay Mujhe Baali Sakina Ki Abhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Takallum Boli
Kehdey Zalim Say Mere Hath Na Bandhey Asghar
